mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_invoice (invoice_id, invoice_type, invoice_no, invoice_code, buyer_name, buyer_tax_no, seller_name, seller_tax_no, invoice_amount, tax_amount, total_amount, invoice_status, issue_time, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{invoiceId}, #{invoiceType}, #{invoiceNo}, #{invoiceCode}, #{buyerName}, #{buyerTaxNo}, #{sellerName}, #{sellerTaxNo}, #{invoiceAmount}, #{taxAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{invoiceStatus}, #{issueTime}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_invoice SET buyer_name = #{buyerName}, buyer_tax_no = #{buyerTaxNo}, seller_name = #{sellerName}, seller_tax_no = #{sellerTaxNo}, invoice_amount = #{invoiceAmount}, tax_amount = #{taxAmount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, invoice_status = #{invoiceStatus}, issue_time = #{issueTime}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_invoice WHERE invoice_no = #{invoiceNo} AND invoice_code = #{invoiceCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_invoice SET invoice_status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId}
